name: Dustin Noah Robinson
source: Dustin is a program manager working at a tech company in San Francisco. He hails from Maine, but lived in Seattle until a bad breakup made him decide to move. He is a huge board gamer, and takes comfort in organization of both information and physical things. He is typically very frank and forward, but friendly, and makes new friends easily.
